module_title: Digital Initiatives in Education: DIKSHA, SWAYAM & SWAYAM PRABHA
introduction: This foundational level introduces the pillars of India's digital education infrastructure. It covers the exact full forms, primary target audiences, and core functions of DIKSHA, SWAYAM, and SWAYAM PRABHA—which are guaranteed 1-mark questions in almost every teaching and NET exam.

core_concepts.title: DIKSHA (Digital Infrastructure for Knowledge Sharing)
core_concepts.description:
Launched by the Ministry of Education (MoE) in 2017. 
- Core Motto: 'One Nation, One Digital Platform'.
- Primary Audience: Originally built for Teachers (to provide training and lesson plans), it has now expanded to students and parents.
- Key Feature: Energized Textbooks (ETBs). Physical NCERT/State board textbooks have printed QR codes. When scanned via the DIKSHA app, the student gets access to mapped digital content (videos, worksheets) for that specific chapter.

core_concepts.title: SWAYAM (Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiring Minds)
core_concepts.description:
India's indigenous MOOC (Massive Open Online Course) platform. 
- Goal: To achieve the three cardinal principles of Education Policy: Access, Equity, and Quality.
- Target Audience: Anyone, anywhere, at any time. It hosts courses from Class 9 to Post-Graduation (PG).
- Cost: All courses are completely FREE to study. A nominal fee is charged only if the learner wants an officially proctored certificate.

core_concepts.title: SWAYAM PRABHA
core_concepts.description:
A group of High-Quality Educational DTH (Direct to Home) TV Channels running 24x7.
- Technology: Uses the GSAT-15 satellite.
- Purpose: To provide educational access to students in remote areas who do not have high-speed internet connections.
- Content Cycle: New content is broadcasted for at least 4 hours every day, which is repeated 5 more times in a day, allowing students to choose their convenient time.

important_entities.name: MOOC (Massive Open Online Course)
important_entities.significance: A MOOC is a web-based distance learning program designed for large numbers of geographically dispersed students. It removes the physical boundaries of a classroom, allowing lakhs of students to learn simultaneously from top-tier professors (e.g., from IITs, IIMs, JNU).

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
Examiners constantly try to confuse these two. 
- If the question mentions an **Online Web Portal / MOOCs**, the answer is **SWAYAM**.
- If the question mentions **DTH TV Channels / GSAT-15 Satellite**, the answer is **SWAYAM PRABHA**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Though students use it, DIKSHA was officially launched as a national platform for **Teacher** training and lesson planning. Remember 'Diksha' as a teacher's name.

exam_strategy_tips: UGC NET Paper 1 heavily tests exact full forms. Memorize them word-for-word: Study Webs of Active-Learning for Young Aspiring Minds (SWAYAM). Do NOT choose 'Study Webs of Academic-Learning'.
